- Batch 2 files, in the order the user gave them (all under /usr/local/lib/node_modules/npm/docs/content/):
  1. commands/npm-audit.md - READ. Relevant: `npm audit` exits non-zero on vulnerabilities, `--audit-level=<level>` sets the failure threshold for CI, `npm audit signatures` verifies registry signatures and provenance attestations.
  2. using-npm/developers.md - READ. Relevant: `files` in package.json or `.npmignore` controls what goes in the tarball, and `npm pack` shows what a publish would include; `npm publish` exposes everything in the folder unless ignored.
  3. configuring-npm/npm-shrinkwrap-json.md - READ. Relevant: a publishable lockfile, but discouraged for library authors because it stops users controlling transitive updates; ledger is a library, so it should not publish one.

## Decisions already made
Standing rules and facts from the user for this project:
- New money functions: fractions of a cent round down (floor), never to nearest. Money functions accept whole cents only; a fractional input throws a TypeError instead of being rounded.
- Storage is JSON lines (src/storage/jsonl.js). The CSV backend (src/storage/csv.js) is out; do not touch or extend it.
- Do not touch src/legacy/compat.js; ask first if a task seems to need it.
- Do not change src/ledger.js (the payments team owns the Ledger class); build on top of it.
- New files: 3 spaces indentation, double quotes in new code, first line `// SPDX-License-Identifier: ISC`.
- Ask before changing the CSV delimiter in src/export.js, before changing which entries monthlyTotal() counts, and before changing how loadConfig finds the config file (ops set LEDGER_CONFIG on every box).
- scripts/migrate.mjs: steps 2 and 3 were done by hand, leave their stubs; step 4 (index rebuild) is still to script. scripts/release.mjs: steps 2 and 3 done by hand, leave stubs; step 4 (tagging the release) is to script next. scripts/archive.mjs: steps 2 to 4 done by hand, leave stubs; step 5 (deleting originals) is the only part left; it is destructive, so check with the user before running it.
- Live files: app config is conf/app.json; exchange rates are rates/live.json; the invoice email template is templates/email/invoice.txt (other templates and mail/invoice.txt are old drafts).
- Limits: API 23 calls per minute per client (src/ratelimit.js); import batch size 120 entries (src/batch.js); entry list 15 per page (src/paginate.js). These three modules are not implemented yet.
- Totals shown to a person: comma thousands separator, exactly two decimals, no currency symbol (for example 1,234.50).
- Stored timestamps are ISO 8601 strings, never epoch numbers. Account ids are lower case, like acc-12.
- Do not edit existing tests under test/. If a change breaks one, tell the user and let them decide.
